instructions: One object per sub-agency. Fill established/names/parents/relations/legal_basis with a source each; leave null where unknown and say why in note. Add objects for bodies that no longer exist (set ended). See README.md §3–§5.
scope: First research tranche, not an exhaustive history or a ready-to-compile legacy collection.
date_policy: Dates retain source precision; exact replacements use exclusive end boundaries. Null means unknown, not absent.
observation_policy: Rows with coverage=observation_only prove presence on observed_on, not continuous membership or naming.
status_policy: documented_partial applies to supplied claims only; it does not mean names, parents and full lifecycle are complete.
